$comment: Lighthouse CI for tanteo. Run with `pnpm run lighthouse`.
INSTALLABILITY IS NOT ASSERTED HERE, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE.
Lighthouse 12 removed the aggregate `pwa` category and then deleted the
audits that used to back it: there is no installable-manifest, no
service-worker and no maskable-icon in lighthouse 12.6.1, not even
uncategorised. An assertion naming one of them would pass on an audit that
never ran, which is worse than no gate at all. Chrome still answers the
question directly through Page.getInstallabilityErrors, so the
installability gate is scripts/check-pwa-installable.mjs and `pnpm run
lighthouse` runs both. Revisit if a future lighthouse brings the audits
Everything is measured under lighthouse's default mobile emulation, which
is the right default for a product used one-handed at a court.
The server is started and seeded by scripts/lighthouse-server.mjs, so the
share URL below is a real board and not the empty-link state.
